mkhas pa slob par 'dod pa'i byis pa ste blun po/ gzhug pa'i/ phyir yin/ / la/ 'on kyang chen po rnams kyis lan 'ga' gzigs gyur na'ang*/ /de yang don med mi 'gyur blo gros skye bar 'gyur snyam sems/ /'di nyid legs par shes na klog gi slob dpon byed la rab tu mkhas par 'gyur/ /de phyir mkhas pa rnams kyang khengs pa dor nas 'di bris legs par slob 'gyur snyam/ /brtse bas 'di bris pa las dub par gyur pas rnyed pa'i bsoXd namaXs gang yod pa/ /des ni 'gro ba mtha' dag byang chub sems ldan spyod pa mchog la gnas kyi bar/ /gang dang gang brjod de dag don gsal don la brjod pa'i zur phyin rab tu mkhas/ / legs sbyar rgya mtsho blo gros yangs pa'i gzungs kyi rtseX moX mchog ni sangs rgyas/ thob par shog/ //yi ge'i bklag thabs byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa zhes bya ba/ shākya'i/ dge bsnyen sa skya'i/ bsod nams rtse mos sbyar ba'o// //sked lhas dgon pa dang

| dpal sa skya'i dben gnas dam par sbyar ba'o/ /phag lo rta pa'i tshes bcu gcig la tshar bar bgyis so/ /zhu ba po zhang ston rje btsun nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mchan bu gna' ro bande gshin rje grags kyi phyag bris kyi dpe las 'phel ba/ ithi/ phyar ru pas bgyis so// //maṅgalaṃ/ byis pa bde 'jug gi rtsa ba dpe rnying zhig gi mjug tu/ sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos tshar gcig gsungs zer ba'i dpe la gtugs so/ /zhes yod pa'i nang | gong gi rtags 'di 'dra'i nang bris pa'i tshig rkang lnga de 'dugakhyad par | de bas sa mtshams bcad pa la zhes pa'i tshig de mchan 'grel 'di dang*/ sa paṇa gyis 'grel pa'i nang du yang bkod 'dug pas sde par la med kyang rtsa tshig yin nges so/ /lce bder 'gyur ba'i yi ge yang sde par dang cung mi 'dra ba 'di ltar 'dug rtharbadzña ṇḍaḍakṣaḥstharṣankanthaḥtregatstsha/yatredhyardzanardzin dhya sha ṇurthorkha rḍhrā/stan ṇugrosmespretaṇutra/ganthibuṣka brimbibā/ya dyāsreko tshtshe | rerkoṇubrekṭa nthaḥsde par du/ rbadzña ṇḍaḍākṣaḥstharṣanka ཿtra tstsha|yark+ratt+yardzanā dhra/ shaṅku rthorweñdzuñdzurdhwa/st+want+yakrosmrosproddha ḍā/ kanthirbhyaṣkabdzimaphā/ya preṅka/ ṅkatshetstshar/ reṅka sreklikt+yirthaḥ 'di nyid bod skad du bsgyur ba sngon chad ma mthong bas bcos thal mi 'byung ba'i ched du ma dpe so sor gang yod ltar dpyad gzhir bris pas mkhas rnams dpyad par zhu/ tshul rgyan pas// // ༄༅/ /yab kyi bstod pa daṇḍa ka'i mchan bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /bdag gis thal mo spyir sbyar nas/ /dang bas bla ma la btud de// dpal ldan kye yi rdo rje la/ /sdeb sbyor daṇḍa ka rgyun chags pa/ sa bstod bgyi/ / gnyis med ye shes dag pa'i nyi ma dang ni shar dkar sogs/ sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ yig las bsgrubs hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i de'i 'od kyis 'og tu/ sa dang ra ba phyogs su/ drwa ba sna sbrel/ gyen la srid rtse la thug gi bar du/ gur phub pa/

dang gur nang du /bla bre 'bar ba'i phyi rol la/ me yi phyi nang gi bdud thams cad zhi bar byed pas srung 'khor ro// nang du ༵༵ brgya sbyin sogs/ phyogs bdag lha'i dge bsnyen sogs zhing skyong mtha' yas sogs lto 'phye'i dbang po mahā bo dhi sogs mchod rten gaṅgā sogs chu dang me dang shingaX dang sgra sgrog sogs chu 'dzin dang ni dbang phyug sogs 'dre dang mgrin bcu sogs srin po mkha' 'gro stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs/ dang ni mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs gar byed pa/ ro dang ro ni mdung gsal shing*/ gis phug dang dum bu dang ni mi'i/ tshil dang mgo gas nas klad pa ser skya lug cing khrag dang skra yi dum dang ro'i bye brag de dag 'thor dang sa gzhi rnams/ rus pas gang zhing keng rus 'dres dbang byas pa'i ro sha med pa dkar po rnams/ gar byed ce spyang pheṃ zhes sgrogs shing kaṃ ka sogs/ bya yi tshogs kyis gang ba'i khrod na grub pa thob pas byin gyis brlabs par rnal 'byor ma dang birwa pa dang klu sgrub la sogs rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs kyis gang ba'i nang don du na lus ni dur khrod yin la/ de yang phyogs skyong ni chos brgyad/ rlung ni zhing skyong*/ ro sa/ me ni me/ chu ni chu/ shing ni rtsa/ sprin ni naXm mkha'/ nad rnams ni klu/ de dag gi dbang gis lus la nad sogs 'byung ba ni 'dre la sogs pa/ de las snang ba ni mchod rten dang rnal 'byor pa'o/ / dbus su chos kyi 'byung thugs rje 'byung gnas gru gsum/ dmar skya'i mdog can 'od gsal ba zhabs zhum zhing*/ gdeng ka gyen du thar pa la/ phyogs pa'i nang na thar pa chen po'i grong khyer rgyu'i yan lag sngon du song ba las byung ba'i gzhal med khang ste sems nyid dag pa'i ngo bo'o/ / ye shes lnga yi rin chen las grub dkar ser nag ljang sngo phyi nas rim pa bzhin ste dbang po dang stobs lnga/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gru bzhi dang ni

rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi sgo bzhis mdzes shing nang du sgo'i g.yas g.yon du brgyad de 'phags lam yan lag brgyad rin chen ka ba phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rdo rje'i gdung dang mchod rten dbyibs glang po'i rgyab sogs rta babs yang dag spong ba bzhi/ steng gi g.yas g.yon du ri dwags dbus su chos kyi 'khor lo de'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ dang bcas shing mda' yab kyi 'og gam drwa phyed kyi 'og na rin po che du ma las grub pa'i pha gu mda' yab mu tig dang padma rā ga la sogs pa'i| rin chen du ma'i drwa ba dang ni drwa phyed pa de dag gi gseb na/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod dang byang chub kyi yan lag bdun me tog phreng ba dril bu dang ni pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab rnams la khor yug tu/ g.yer ka'i phreng dang rgyal mtshan brgyad dam bcu drug che dang ba dan brgyad dam bcu drug mdzes bcas pha gu dang mda' yab kyi nang logs/ rnga yab dar gyi lda ldi ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod dag pa/ sa brgyan la kha khyer gyi/ mchod snam dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ steng na lha mo'i tshogs rnams gzugs rdo rje ma sogs me long*/ pi wang*/ dung chos/ snod mchog chos 'byung*| me tog bdug pa sogs/ mchod rdzas du mas lag brel dbu rgyan sogs/ mdzes pa'i rgyan can bzhad sgra sogs/ 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang drug gi rjes su skyes sogs/ glu yi dbyangs can phan tshun chags pa dang mdzes pa'i/ zur mig lta dang bcas pa grangs las 'das pa/ du mas gang zhing pho brang rtse mor rdo rje dang ni yid bzhin gyi/ nor bu rin chen las bsgrubs tshad med pa/ ches mtho rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris pa la/ ka thung du ma btsugs pas thog phib pa/ steng gtsang khang phyur bur byas pa ste/ mdzes pa'i dbus su shar dkar sogs| sna tshogs 'dod chags rnam par dag pa/

padma'i lte bar zlum po'i steng na/ phung po'i bdud bcom pa'i brdar gdong bzhi tshangs pa ser po lag pa bzhi pa po ti dang srad bu 'dzin pa/ bzhi dang ni nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom pa'i brdar dbang po dkar po dang bcas 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom pa'i brdar 'jug sel khyab 'jug sngon po lag pa bzhi pa/ 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ mda'/ nor bu'o| | dag dang lha'i bu'i bdud bcom pa'i brdar drag po dbang phyug nag po lag pa bzhi pa/ rtse gsum| rag sha'i phreng ba bzung ba/ rnams ni skrag pas rtabs shing 'gyel la posti dang rtse gsum sogs| lag cha shor nas thal mo sbyar ba brkyang ba/ zhing gdong gis skrag pa dang dad pas bcom ldan 'das la gyen du lta ba rnams kyi snying ga'i steng du nyon mongs pa'i mun pa las grol bas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'am nyon mongs sel ba'i brdar/ tsha zer can gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan sems can gyi don la/ rab dgyes srid 'khor ba/ zhi myang 'das/ mnyam par de la mi gnas/ 'joms pa mi gnas myang 'das/ de ni chos nyid rang bzhin nam mkha'i mdog ngo bo chos nyid las mi 'gyur ba/ rtags sku mdog sngo nag gis mtshon| dang byams pa'i thugs las mi 'gyur bas cung zad char sprin mdog la utpal sngo dang baiḍūrya ltar sngo la rnam thar gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam par thar pa stong par mthong ba la sogs pa brgyad rang bzhin zhal brgyad pa ste g.yas ni chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas chu shel mdog la thugs rjes sems can la chags pas/ padma rā ga'i mdog tu g.yon pa snang zhing lhag ma drug po/ rnams ni du ba'i mdog chos nyid las mi 'gyur ba'i ngo bo sngar dang 'dra'o// la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pas ral pa dmar ser gyen du langs shing zhal rnams re rer sku gsung thugs dag pas/ spyan gsum thugs rjes sems can la rjes su chags pas dmar la bdud bzhi skrag par mdzad pas/
